svg.title: B cell
svg.desc: Small round B lymphocyte with a large nucleus and multiple Y-shaped membrane immunoglobulins. Biological basis: Mature B cells display clonally rearranged membrane immunoglobulin that captures cognate antigen and initiates receptor-mediated uptake.
